tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Execute a command on the host using a shell. Ordinary commands use pipes; tty=true provides interactive PTY input. Return output, state and a session_id; continue running commands with write_stdin instead of launching them again. Files, search, Git, builds and tests are available through installed commands. No Codex agent or model is called. Read the command output from the output field in structuredContent; the same chunk is also available in text content. Optional label identifies a task. Set capture_output=true for bounded disk logs that remain queryable after memory eviction or restart. History metadata is persisted by default; command text and raw output are not persisted by default.

workdir.description: Working directory. Relative values resolve against the fixed server cwd; omitted uses that cwd.

shell.description: Optional absolute shell executable path; omitted uses the shell resolved at server startup.

login.description: Use a login shell. False avoids loading login startup files for each command.

tty.description: Allocate a PTY when input or terminal semantics are required. Otherwise stdin is closed and output uses pipes.

yield_time_ms.description: Maximum wait for this initial response, not a process timeout. Completed commands return immediately; a still-running command returns when this wait expires.

max_output_tokens.description: Approximate text budget: at most min(4 * value, 65536) UTF-8 bytes. Not an exact model token count.

timeout_ms.description: Optional total process lifetime in milliseconds. Omitted means no automatic execution deadline.

request_id.description: Optional per-instance retry key; identical operations only. The creation response is pinned while its command is active. Completed deduplication is bounded by a separate TTL and capacity; no cross-restart exactly-once guarantee.

label.description: Optional task label, for example build/frontend; persisted in metadata and available for filtering.

capture_output.description: Opt into disk capture from the beginning of this command, bounded by archive quotas. Raw output may contain secrets. Omitted uses history.record_output (default false).

outputSchema.title: Execution output, status and cursor
outputSchema.description: Schema of structuredContent. Normal results include the bounded output chunk and execution metadata; a pre-result operation failure has only error. The same output chunk is also carried in text content for compatibility. Read MCP isError as well.

tools.name: write_stdin
tools.description: Send characters to an existing PTY session or poll output with empty chars. Read process state and exit_code to determine completion. An ended session may still contain unread output. Non-empty input to pipe sessions fails with STDIN_CLOSED. Use longer bounded waits for quiet long tasks; do not launch the command again. Read the command output from the output field in structuredContent; the same chunk is also available in text content. For read-only tail or literal search use tail_lines or search. For disk logs pass archive_id together with its session_id; history reads default to offset 0 and never accept input. Inspect archive_truncated; archived records cannot resume old processes. Search returns matches and search_next_cursor, not concatenated output.

chars.description: Characters to write; empty means read only. Control characters retain PTY semantics.

yield_time_ms.description: Maximum wait for this response only; not a process timeout. Return earlier when output or completion is available. Omitted defaults to 250 ms for input, 5000 ms for empty polls.

max_output_tokens.description: Approximate text budget: at most min(4 * value, 65536) UTF-8 bytes. Not an exact model token count.

output_cursor.description: Explicit UTF-8 log byte offset. Omitting uses and advances the session default cursor; an explicit read does not advance that default.

request_id.description: Optional per-instance retry key; identical operations only. The creation response is pinned while its command is active. Completed deduplication is bounded by a separate TTL and capacity; no cross-restart exactly-once guarantee.

archive_id.description: Stable archived execution ID returned by a previous result or scope=history listing. This is not a filesystem path.

search.description: Read-only literal case-sensitive UTF-8 search, not a regular expression. Matches are returned in matches; continue with search_next_cursor. Does not advance the default log cursor.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Edit files using the Codex-style *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch format, provided as the JSON patch string. Supports Add File, Update File, Delete File, Move to and multiple hunks. Not git unified diff and not a freeform MCP argument. Existing Add/Move destinations are rejected. Multi-file changes are not atomic; inspect partial failures.

tools.name: list_exec_sessions
tools.description: List execution records, with workdir, label, outcome and ordering filters. Default scope=current preserves in-memory session behavior; scope=history reads bounded disk history across service restarts. Historical unknown means the final process outcome was not confirmed, not a failed or resumable task. Use archive_id with write_stdin to read captured logs. Never rerun a command just because its cache record was evicted.

outcome.description: Optional result filter; unknown denotes a previous instance whose final outcome was not recorded.

tools.name: discover_skills
tools.description: Discover/search local project and user skills for a new substantive development task. Pass the absolute target workdir and a concise task query (include relevant technical keywords). Returns bounded metadata only, never instructions or execution. Omit query to browse, continue with cursor, or refresh=true to recheck disk. Skip simple checks, output polling and unchanged-task continuations. When read_skill is enabled, read selected instructions with it before acting; metadata alone is insufficient. No relevant match: proceed normally. Experimental, opt-in.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor; repeat workdir/query, never combine with refresh.

warnings.description: Bounded diagnostic notices; never raw parser input or credentials.

next_cursor.description: Continue with the same arguments; null indicates the current listing/resource is complete.

error.description: Pre-result failure. Also inspect MCP isError.

outputSchema.description: Bounded structuredContent mirrored in one text result for MCP compatibility. Inspect isError and completeness/cursor fields; discovery and reading never execute a skill.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Read a selected local skill or a necessary text resource. Pass absolute workdir and the discovered ID, or an exact unambiguous name for a user-named skill (no discovery round trip needed). resource defaults to SKILL.md; relative resources resolve inside skill_root, NOT workdir. Read selected instructions fully, following next_cursor until content_complete=true before task actions. Repeat workdir/skill/resource/explicit when continuing. explicit=true only when the user explicitly selected the skill; never grants permissions. Does not execute scripts or install dependencies. Experimental, opt-in.
